public_rationale: The reliability concern holds in the tested customer-service tasks: errors were substantial and repeated success was less dependable. The categorical novelty claim is too strong under the ordinary reading adopted here. An LLM-based search system contributed a new mathematical construction that an external university account recognized. That does not establish independent conceptual understanding or a fundamental breakthrough. The novelty verdict depends on counting verified new constructions as novel ideas and including LLMs used with search and verification.
limitations: The interpretation of novel concepts determines the novelty finding.
AlphaEvolve is a combined system, not an unaided chatbot.
Reliability results are specific to the tested models, tasks and supporting software.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLMs do not create novel concepts and are inconsistent and unreliable.

statement.excerpt: Large Language Models do not create novel concepts, they are inconsistent and unreliable, and even the “good” things they do vary wildly thanks to the dramatic variance of a giant probability machine.

from_speaker: Large Language Models do not create novel concepts
even the “good” things they do vary wildly
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that LLMs cannot originate useful new ideas or methods and cannot consistently deliver correct results. Novel wording alone does not count as conceptual novelty.
LLM-generated methods tested by external evaluators count as contributions from LLMs, while the contribution of search, verification and human problem selection must remain explicit.
There is no standard reporting quarter for model capabilities. I use the current 2025 evaluation year through publication, reflecting the post's retrospective discussion of the past year.
Reliability means repeated correctness on specified tasks, not identical wording. No universal acceptable error rate is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Evaluations show substantial repeated-task failures and provide strong evidence that apparent novel ideas are reproductions of existing ideas. Reliability failures alone cannot establish the categorical absence of novelty.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented LLM contribution produces a genuinely new, independently checked idea or method. Reliable performance on some tasks also limits any reading that all uses are unreliable.

evidence.explanation: The study ran each task four times and reported substantial failures, with repeated-success scores declining as more successful trials were required. This supports the reliability concern in the tested customer-service tasks, without establishing that all LLM uses fail.

evidence.locator: Section Advancing the frontiers in mathematics and algorithm discovery
evidence.explanation: The announcement describes Gemini-generated programs combined with evolutionary search and automated verification producing previously unknown mathematical constructions. This contradicts the ordinary blanket denial of useful novelty, subject to the distinction between a new construction and a fundamental new concept.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning There had been no movement
evidence.explanation: An external university account recognizes AlphaEvolve's improved bound while discussing competing human mathematical work. It corroborates that the result advanced existing knowledge, although it does not document a fresh replication of the complete discovery process.

evidence.explanation: This GUI-testing study reports high execution consistency for one tested model with guardrails. It limits generalization from failure-heavy benchmarks, but does not establish dependable performance across all tasks.
